record.title: Derive the complete SPU candidate and software selection schema
record.intent: Recover eight SPU writes and pin the writable inputs that select their operands.
requirements: Pin the unchanged stock ELF, function ranges, encoded instructions and relocations supporting all eight writes and both independent sample-mode selectors.
Use typed Kotlin tooling and TOML evidence to derive a fixed candidate from domain8 series900 record2 count16 modes1and4 and checkpoint shadows control1 gain0 TX0 ADC-control0.
Label control1 as post-first-bitset state; do not infer pre-SPU control uniquely.
Define bounded repeated capture of globals, all nine selection records, selected sample records0/1/15, bindings and shadows with exact comparison and immediate rejection on mismatch.
Preserve the validated ADC input protocol and fixtures; independently verify candidate operands and capture addresses without running a guest.
acceptance: Deterministic candidate and capture contract are independently checked and committed and pushed before observer implementation.
